title: Language and Blue Hour
author: Theo Coldharbour
blurb: Kestrel Halloran, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
